content.adaptation_note: The plan is structured for a beginner with 2 days per week. Focus on mastering form before increasing weight or volume. The 5-minute warm-up is included in the session time. Rest periods are set to 45 seconds to allow for recovery while maintaining a brisk pace.
content.safety_note: Always listen to your body. If you experience pain (not to be confused with muscle soreness), stop the exercise. Ensure your incline push-up surface is stable and at a height that allows you to maintain a straight body line.

content.safety_note: Always listen to your body. Stop any exercise if you feel sharp pain. Ensure your workspace is clear of obstacles. If you have any pre-existing medical conditions, consult a healthcare professional before starting a new exercise program.

content.adaptation_note: As a beginner, focus on mastering form before increasing weight or volume. If a session feels too intense, reduce the number of sets or rest longer between exercises. The plan includes a mix of strength, core, and light cardio to build a solid foundation for energy and strength goals.
content.safety_note: Always warm up before starting. Stop any exercise if you feel pain (not just muscle burn). Ensure your equipment is stable and the area is clear of obstacles. Consult a healthcare provider before starting a new exercise program if you have any medical conditions.
